description: Service Worker script that intercepts fetch requests and logs request URLs.

methods.name: addEventListener
methods.description: Registers event listeners for 'fetch' and 'activate' events.

methods.name: respondWith
methods.description: Method of the FetchEvent that handles the response for the intercepted request.

methods.name: waitUntil
methods.description: Method of the ExtendableEvent that signals ongoing operations like clients.claim() to extend the lifetime of the event.

methods.name: clients.claim
methods.description: Activates the service worker for all current clients.
